Everything you need to grow

An open-source headless backend, automatic translations, Stripe payments, and a REST API that gives you full freedom.

Automatic multilingual

Your entire site gets translated automatically. You choose which languages.

Go live fast, no hassle

Upload products manually or import from Excel. From concept to live site in under an hour.

Payments via Stripe

Mobile-first design
